steps.name: three detached ratings made by importing a synthetic export (its dry run, then its plan)
steps.script: const base = await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Export'); if (base.status !== 200) { throw new Error('export ' + base.status); } const env = base.json; const m = __vars.movie; const d = (n) => n.slice(0, 8) + '-' + n.slice(8, 12) + '-' + n.slice(12, 16) + '-' + n.slice(16, 20) + '-' + n.slice(20); const at = (h) => new Date(Date.now() - h * 3600000).toISOString(); const row = (id, user, name, ghost, stars, text, reason, h) => ({ Id: d(id), UserId: d(user), UserName: name, ItemId: d(ghost), Identity: { ItemId: d(ghost), Kind: 'Movie', Name: m.name, Year: m.year, ProviderIds: m.providerIds }, Stars: stars, ReviewText: text, IsSpoiler: false, CreatedUtc: at(h + 24), UpdatedUtc: at(h + 24), ReviewUpdatedUtc: text ? at(h + 24) : null, EditCount: 0, DetachedUtc: at(h), DetachReason: reason }); const r = __vars.rows; env.Data.Ratings = [row(r.a, __vars.ids.viewer, 'viewer', r.ghostA, 4.5, "data webcheck detached review: kept as text & whole.", 'Removed', 30), row(r.b, __vars.ids.viewer2, 'viewer2', r.ghostB, 3, null, 'Missing', 29), row(r.c, __vars.ids.viewer2, 'viewer2', r.ghostC, 2, null, 'Unmatched', 28)]; const go = async (dry, plan) => { const s = await __jfurDetails.server('POST', 'UserRatings/Admin/Import?mode=Merge&mapUsersBy=Id&dryRun=' + dry + (plan ? '&ifPlan=' + plan : ''), env); if (s.status !== 202) { throw new Error('import ' + s.status + ' ' + JSON.stringify(s.json)); } let j = s.json; for (let i = 0; i < 240 && (j.State === 'Queued' || j.State === 'Running'); i++) { await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 500)); j = (await __jfurDetails.server('GET', 'UserRatings/Admin/Jobs/' + s.json.Id)).json; } if (j.State !== 'Succeeded') { throw new Error('the import job ' + j.State + ' ' + (j.ErrorCode || '') + ' ' + (j.Error || '')); } return j.Report; }; const dry = await go(true, null); const real = await go(false, dry.PlanToken); return { dry: dry.Outcomes, real: real.Outcomes, unusable: (dry.Unusable || 0) + (real.Unusable || 0), safety: real.SafetySnapshot || null };
